examples.en: The game was postponed because of the rain.
Is it okay if we postpone the meeting until next week?
Something came up, so we decided to put off the trip.
We are going to postpone the event because of the typhoon.
I'm sorry, but please push our appointment back by a day.

examples.ko: 일이 많아서 결혼식을 내년으로 연기할 거예요.
examples.en: I have a lot going on, so we will postpone the wedding until next year.

explain: '연기하다'는 회의, 경기, 행사, 약속처럼 정해진 일정을 뒤로 미룰 때 써요. 일상에서는 '미루다'도 많이 쓰는데, '숙제를 미루다'처럼 습관적으로 늦출 때도 자연스러워요. 반대로 날짜를 당길 때는 '앞당기다'를 써요.

phrases.en: We are postponing the meeting schedule to next week.
phrases.nuance_ko: 정해 둔 약속이나 계획의 날짜를 뒤로 미룰 때 쓴다.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when pushing back the date of an appointment or plan that was already set.

explain_en: '연기하다' is used when you push back a fixed schedule such as a meeting, game, event or appointment. In daily talk '미루다' is also common and also works for putting things off out of habit, like '숙제를 미루다'. The opposite, moving a date earlier, is '앞당기다'.

dis.h: play a role as an actor

p.n: 연극하다 does not take a role as its object, so it is not natural here.
